angle: Motivates least squares from the sign-cancellation failure of raw residuals on a mean line, then hunts the optimum by rotating the line through live error sums toward a zero-derivative picture rather than solving normal equations.
angle_detail: Watch [01:21] first for the residual sign problem and the move to squaring, then [04:04] where rotations drive the sum down and back up. The A/B slope-intercept symbols here may clash with course beta notation, so translate before writing exam answers. Skip hand-derivative mechanics near [08:17], which the video itself marks computer work; the concept of zero slope at the minimum is the takeaway.
